ui-chrome.purpose: system-ui / -apple-system / Segoe UI sans stack; all interactive/chrome text.

mono.purpose: ui-monospace / Cascadia Code / SF Mono / Consolas; SHAs, diffs, file paths, commit metadata.

shadows.name: confirm-dialog
shadows.purpose: The system's one drop-shadow, reserved for ConfirmDialog's always-on-top modal.

components.name: DiffView line
components.description: One diff line: old/new line no. (tabular-nums, muted, right-aligned), +/- marker, content. Add/remove tint over the good/critical status tokens; context carries no tint.
components.html: 1213+const x = 1;
components.css: .ds-diff-line { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 3.5em 3.5em 1em 1fr; align-items: baseline; white-space: pre; font-family: ui-monospace, "Cascadia Code", "SF Mono", Consolas, monospace; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-diff-line-no { color: #898781; text-align: right; padding-right: 8px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-diff-line-marker { text-align: center; } .ds-diff-line--add { background: color-mix(in srgb, #0ca30c 14%, transparent); } .ds-diff-line--add .ds-diff-line-marker, .ds-diff-line--add .ds-diff-line-content { color: #0ca30c; } .ds-diff-line--remove { background: color-mix(in srgb, #d03b3b 14%, transparent); } .ds-diff-line--remove .ds-diff-line-marker, .ds-diff-line--remove .ds-diff-line-content { color: #d03b3b; }

components.name: ConfirmDialog
components.description: Generic destructive-action confirmation modal — title, message, Cancel + Confirm, Confirm swaps to the critical token when destructive.
components.html:
Discard changes?

Discard changes to "file.ts"? This cannot be undone.
components.css: .ds-confirm-overlay { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-confirm-dialog { width: min(420px, 90vw); background: #1a1a19; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.32); padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; } .ds-confirm-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0; color: #ffffff; } .ds-confirm-message { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0; color: #c3c2b7; } .ds-confirm-actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; } .ds-confirm-cancel, .ds-confirm-confirm { height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; } .ds-confirm-cancel { background: #0d0d0d; color: #ffffff; } .ds-confirm-confirm--destructive { background: #d03b3b; border-color: #d03b3b; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: FileStatusIcon
components.description: Single uppercase status-letter glyph, monospace, colored via the status tokens, with a visually-hidden text label. Shared verbatim by ChangesPanel and DetailPanel.
components.css: .ds-file-status-icon { display: inline-block; width: 14px; font-weight: 700; font-family: ui-monospace, "Cascadia Code", "SF Mono", Consolas, monospace; text-align: center; }

narrative.overview: GitHydra's interface treats the commit graph the way a transit map treats a rail network — branches are lines, merges are interchange stations, commits are stops. Dark graphite UI ground by default, one restrained accent for UI chrome, branch lanes carry their own saturated color from a validated 8-hue categorical set. System UI font stack for chrome; monospace for SHAs/diffs/metadata. Operate mode: legibility and information density outrank visual flourish.
keyCharacteristics: Schematic transit-map diagram grammar applied to real git topology
Dark graphite default with a validated light-theme equivalent
One restrained UI accent, separate from the 8-hue categorical branch-lane channel
Fixed status tokens (good/warning/serious/critical) always paired with icon + label, never color alone
Monospace convention shared across SHAs, diffs, file paths, and commit metadata

rules.name: The No Single-Click Destruction Rule
rules.body: Any action that discards user data must route through ConfirmDialog — never a bare click-to-delete control.

rules.name: The Independent-Scroll Rule
rules.body: A panel's file list and its detail pane scroll independently of each other and of the panel chrome; neither a long file list nor a long diff should force the other out of view.

dos: Do reuse DiffView, FileStatusIcon, and ConfirmDialog verbatim rather than forking per-surface variants.
Do apply the existing good/warning/serious/critical status tokens to any new file- or operation-status surface rather than inventing new status colors.
Do use the two-region split (fixed list column + flexible detail column, each independently scrolling) for any future panel that pairs a list with a detail view.
donts: Don't add a drop-shadow anywhere except ConfirmDialog's always-on-top modal context.
Don't show diff add/remove color without the existing text label/marker relief (+/-) alongside it.
Don't let a destructive action skip ConfirmDialog, even for a single file.
